page.meaning: Relative document path of nonempty slash-separated segments. ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen only in each segment; segments . and .. are forbidden. The extension must be md, png, jpg, svg or txt.

body.meaning: Document bytes returned directly, at most 4194304 bytes.

content_type.meaning: HTTP Content-Type selected from the file extension.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes; The document response is raw bytes on success; peer denial and document failures carry these signals.
